newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Agip to extract oil in Gabon.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Agip to extract oil in Gabon.

text.p: Italian oil company Agip SpA has signed an agreement with the government of Gabon to develop the offshore Limande oilfield, parent company ENI SpA said in a statement on Friday.
It said initial crude oil output from the field, which Agip had discovered during an exploration concession, was estimated at 10,000 barrels per day.
"Agip intends to put the field into production immediately and to assess the opportunity of acquiring further areas of exploratory interest in Gabon," the statement said.
It said the agreement would reinforce Agip's productive position in West Africa, where it is already active in Nigeria, Angola and Congo.
